Redline Ram.name: Redline Ram
Redline Ram.description: The user charges at top speed shoulder-first along a straight line and does not stop for what is in the way. Every enemy along a street-length line takes heavy bludgeoning damage and is thrown aside, and the user bursts through a door or an inner wall, knocks a parked car out of the way and keeps going; the charge cannot pick targets, so anyone else in the line is hit too. Strain: heavy.
